1.web: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
1.asv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus in behalf of you Gentiles,—

2.web: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;
2.asv: if so be that ye have heard of the dispensation of that grace of God which was given me to you-ward;

3.web: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
3.asv: how that by revelation was made known unto me the mystery, as I wrote before in few words,

4.web: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;
4.asv: whereby, when ye read, ye can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

5.web: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;
5.asv: which in other generations was not made known unto the sons of men, as it hath now been revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

6.web: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
6.asv: to wit, that the Gentiles are fellow-heirs, and fellow-members of the body, and fellow-partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,

7.web: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
7.asv: whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

8.web: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
8.asv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach unto the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

9.web: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;
9.asv: and to make all men see what is the dispensation of the mystery which for ages hath been hid in God who created all things;

10.web: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
10.asv: to the intent that now unto the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places might be made known through the church the manifold wisdom of God,

11.web: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;
11.asv: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

12.web: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
12.asv: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

13.web: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
13.asv: Wherefore I ask that ye may not faint at my tribulations for you, which are your glory.

14.web: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
14.asv: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father,

15.web: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
15.asv: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

16.web: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;
16.asv: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that ye may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

17.web: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
17.asv: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

18.web: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
18.asv: may be strong to apprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

19.web: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
19.asv: and to know the love of Christ which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled unto all the fulness of God.

20.web: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
20.asv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

21.web: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.
21.asv: unto him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus unto all generations for ever and ever. Amen.
